title: Taboo Tattoo
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Middle schooler Seigi, a martial artist who wants to protect the weak, rescues a homeless man from thugs and is branded with a tattoo that turns out to be a powerful secret weapon. Rival tattoo users, including a formidable girl with her own tattoo, come after him in super-powered battles. Complete in 13 volumes; Yen Press rates it Older Teen.
life_message: Strength is worth having when it is used to protect people weaker than you.

content.note: Super-powered battles; MU lists murder, assassination and mutilation; publisher synopsis stresses life-or-death fights, OT rating.
Ecchi genre; MU lists groping and molesting; MangaDex rates it erotica. Lead is a middle schooler. Capped at 3 under the two-source rule; likely higher (to verify).
